resources.string: Experimental local vision OCR for Documents on 64-bit devices. Two files: 1.34 GiB; inference needs more memory. Publisher languages: English, Chinese, French, Spanish, Russian, German, Japanese and Korean. Arabic and phone performance are unverified. Select it in Documents after installing both files.
Select the exact ONNX or GGUF files linked for your engine. File names can change; SHA-256 checks identify and verify every file.
This controls read-aloud only. PDF and DOCX text can use any language regardless of the OCR reader. Voice support depends on your selected engine.
